tools.name: add_task
tools.justification: Creates one new task in the user's private Things database. It changes user data but does not modify or remove an existing task and does not access the public web.

tools.name: add_tasks
tools.justification: Creates a bounded batch of new tasks in the user's private Things database. It changes user data but does not modify or remove existing tasks and does not access the public web.

tools.name: preview_task
tools.justification: Validates task data and returns a token-free preview URI without opening Things or changing user data.

tools.name: get_status
tools.justification: Reads local platform, application availability, and a credential-presence flag without returning the credential or changing state.

tools.name: configure_auth_token
tools.justification: Stores a user-provided Things credential in private local configuration and can overwrite the previously stored credential, so the change is destructive even though it does not alter task data or access the public web.
